text: dsh-antigravity 是 DSH Web 的 Google Antigravity 模型提供商，通过 LLM adapter 接入 Gemini、Claude 和 GPT-OSS，并在设置页提供 OAuth 登录、账号池、模型选择与额度查看。请求按会话和额度状态调度。需要 Google 账号授权，模型请求会发送至 Google 服务。

dsh-antigravity adds Google Antigravity models to DSH Web through an LLM adapter, with OAuth sign-in, account pool management, model selection, and quota views in settings. It schedules requests by session and quota state. A Google account is required; requests are sent to Google services.
想在 DSH Web 里使用 Google Antigravity 提供的 Gemini 模型。
我想把几个 Google 账号接入模型服务并查看各自额度。
How can I use Antigravity models from the DSH model picker?
dsh-antigravity 的功能「Antigravity 模型接入」：向 DSH 注册模型提供商，供模型选择器调用 Gemini、Claude 和 GPT-OSS 等模型，并将请求结果作为流式响应返回。
dsh-antigravity 的功能「账号池与额度面板」：在 DSH Web 设置中通过 Google OAuth 管理账号、查看配额并选择模型；调度器会依据会话、额度和在途请求选账号。
dsh-antigravity Google OAuth 授权交换及模型、配额请求会发送至 Google 服务；凭证与模型设置保存在 DSH 本机 storages 目录。

English | [简体中文](./README.zh.md) Google Antigravity / Cloud Code Assist model provider for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness).

dsh-antigravity README · dsh-antigravity：Based on [LiZhenNet/dsh-antigravity](https://github.com/LiZhenNet/dsh-antigravity), with a multi-account pool added: you can sign in with several Google accounts and requests are scheduled across them. See [QUOTA-SCHEDULING.md](./QUOTA-SCHEDULING.md) for how scheduling works.

> Unofficial integration. This project is not affiliated with or endorsed by Google. Use it only with accounts and services you are authorized to access.

dsh-antigravity README · Method 1: Install from GitHub (Recommended)：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:almost-nowhere/dsh-antigravity
```

dsh-antigravity README · Method 2: Local Release Package：```sh
npm run pack:dist
dsh plugin --profile web add ./dist/dsh-antigravity-0.0.9.tgz
```

Or add to your profile's `cordis.patch.yml`:

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: llm-antigravity
      name: dsh-antigravity
```

---

dsh-antigravity README · Login & Authentication：Open **Settings > Antigravity** and click **Login** to authorize via Google OAuth. The settings page automatically refreshes your quota upon login. You can add multiple accounts in the settings view to configure a pool.

The plugin starts a loopback OAuth callback server at `http://localhost:51121/oauth-callback`. If your browser does not open automatically, run the CLI helper:

```sh
node "$DSH_HOME/profiles/web/node_modules/dsh-antigravity/bin/antigravity-login.mjs"
```

dsh-antigravity README · Login & Authentication：Credentials are saved at: `$DSH_HOME/storages/antigravity-oauth.json`.

---
dsh-antigravity README · Models：Select **Antigravity** in the DSH model picker. You can configure individual models in **Settings > Antigravity**.
